# AwesomeSwiftUI

> Copy-paste SwiftUI components, animations and transitions for iOS 18 through iOS 27. Swift 6, MIT. There is no package: download the file of a component and add it to the project. A component drawn by a Metal shader has a second file, which its entry links: add both. Each component states its minimum iOS.

Search `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/magnoscg/AwesomeSwiftUI/HEAD/catalog.json` by keyword, in English or Spanish, and fetch the `rawURL` of the match, and its `shaderRawURL` when it has one.

## Components

- [Breathing Guide Circle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/magnoscg/AwesomeSwiftUI/HEAD/Components/Animations/BreathingGuideCircle/BreathingGuideCircle.swift): A circle that expands and contracts through breathe in, hold and breathe out phases, with a label and a countdown. iOS 18.0+. Animations. Keywords: breathing, meditation, mindfulness, guide, circle, calm, wellness, respiración, meditación, atención plena, guía, círculo, calma, bienestar.
- [Keyframe Timeline Showcase](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/magnoscg/AwesomeSwiftUI/HEAD/Components/Animations/KeyframeTimelineShowcase/KeyframeTimelineShowcase.swift): A view animated by keyframe tracks for scale, offset and color, with the tracks and a playhead drawn on one shared timeline. iOS 18.0+. Animations. Keywords: keyframes, keyframe animator, timeline, animation, tracks, scale, color animation, fotogramas clave, línea de tiempo, animación, pistas, escala, animación de color.
- [Phase Animator Cycle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/magnoscg/AwesomeSwiftUI/HEAD/Components/Animations/PhaseAnimatorCycle/PhaseAnimatorCycle.swift): A card that loops through several phases of scale, rotation and color. iOS 18.0+. Animations. Keywords: phase animator, phases, loop, card, animation, rotation, scale, animador de fases, fases, bucle, tarjeta, animación, rotación.
- [Split Flap Counter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/magnoscg/AwesomeSwiftUI/HEAD/Components/Animations/SplitFlapCounter/SplitFlapCounter.swift): A split-flap display where each digit flips down to its new value. iOS 18.0+. Text. Keywords: rotating words, word swap, push transition, headline, hero text, cycling text, palabras rotatorias, cambiar palabras, transición, titular, texto cíclico, encabezado.
- [Scramble Text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/magnoscg/AwesomeSwiftUI/HEAD/Components/Text/ScrambleText/ScrambleText.swift): Random characters that settle from left to right into the final text. iOS 18.0+. - [Shimmer Text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/magnoscg/AwesomeSwiftUI/HEAD/Components/Text/ShimmerText/ShimmerText.swift): Text with a band of light that sweeps across its letters through a mask. iOS 18.0+. Text. Keywords: shimmer, shine, highlight, loading, mask, text animation, slide to unlock, brillo, destello, reflejo, cargando, máscara, animación de texto.
- [Streaming Text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/magnoscg/AwesomeSwiftUI/HEAD/Components/Text/StreamingText/StreamingText.swift): Text that arrives in chunks, like the answer of a language model, and fades each new part in from its first letter to its last. iOS 18.0+. Text. Keywords: streaming text, llm, ai answer, token stream, fade in, chat, text renderer, texto en streaming, llm, respuesta de ia, flujo de tokens, aparecer, chat, text renderer.
